description: Struggling with cluttered pie charts that are hard to read and waste valuable report space? The Bar of Pie custom visual helps you present category distributions clearly and efficiently by separating smaller slices into a stacked bar chart. This improves readability, enhances area utilization, and keeps your reports clean and professional. When users wish to display a limited number of categories, a standard pie chart works well. However, as the number of categories increases, pie charts quickly become crowded and difficult to interpret. The Bar of Pie visual solves this problem by shifting smaller slices into a structured stacked bar chart while preserving the overall distribution context. Why use Bar of Pie? Improve readability when category count increases Reduce visual clutter and overlapping labels Make better use of dashboard space Maintain context while highlighting key contributors The Bar of Pie Visual can be used in two powerful ways: 1. Top N Mode Select the top slices to display in the main Pie Chart on the left-hand side Automatically group remaining categories into an “Other” bucket Display remaining elements in a stacked Power BI Bar Chart on the right-hand side Perfect for Pareto-style analysis and focused reporting 2.
